title: Session Tracing: Auditing Reasoning Steps and Tool Call Latency

steps.prompt: Which Salesforce observability schema allows architects to inspect the exact reasoning sequence, executed tool parameters, response latency, and token consumption of an Agentforce session?

options.label: Session Tracing Data Model (STDM) queried via Data Cloud or Agentforce Analytics
options.rationale: The Session Tracing Data Model (STDM) records step-by-step reasoning trajectories, tool call inputs/outputs, latency breakdowns, and token metrics for comprehensive auditing.

options.label: Apex Debug Logs configured with FINEST profiling on the automated process user
options.distractorAntipattern: Apex debug logs capture server-side code lines, not generative reasoning steps or token telemetry.
options.rationale: Debug logs capture in-org Apex code execution, not distributed LLM reasoning loops, tool planning decisions, or token usage metrics.

options.label: Event Monitoring Real-Time Event Streams for Lightning URI and API execution events
options.distractorAntipattern: Standard Real-Time Event Monitoring streams track user interaction and API calls, not agentic reasoning trajectories.
options.rationale: Standard event monitoring tracks user web logins and API calls, but lacks specialized agentic tracing objects and tool telemetry.
